title: Supported-version upgrade proof
summary: Reproduce upgrade from each applicable package's latest supported immutable release to the exact `1.0.0` candidate in pristine consumers.
why: `@plan/knowledge/research-P17-design.json` §7; D96; DOD-21. A monorepo tag or source diff does not prove Composer resolution, discovery, migrations and persisted compatibility for split packages.

include: Read-only baseline discovery; reviewed immutable baseline manifest; populated fixtures; candidate update; idempotent retry/forward recovery; API/schema/config comparison; never-published classification.
exclude: Customer production data; arbitrary historical versions; rollback after committed migration; remote writes; re-tagging a baseline; product repair.
